## How this work is cited

Passages inside Zhuangzi are identified by chapter (篇) by name. Only the seven 'inner chapters' are generally accepted as Zhuangzi's own; the outer and miscellaneous chapters are the work of a school. Which layer a passage comes from is part of what the locator tells a reader.
